title: Wall Mounted Paper Towel Holder 15.5-Inch | Brass Paper Towel Holders | Allied Brass
body_html:
Free up countertop space and keep paper towels right where you cook, prep, and clean. This wall mount paper towel holder delivers an industrial pipe-fitting look designed to blend with both modern and traditional kitchen decor.

  • More working room at the counter — wall-mounted installation saves valuable surface space.
  • Coordinated, transitional style — Pipeline-inspired pipe fitting design pairs easily with versatile accessories.
  • Cleaner-looking finish — protected with a highly durable powder coat for a decorative, clean appearance.
  • Made for daily use — quality materials resist corrosion and rust for continual service.
  • Secure, matched installation — mounts firmly with color coordinated screws and included mounting hardware.

Specs & Details
Mounting: Wall mount
Dimensions (L x H x W): 15.5 x 3 x 4 in.
Shipping weight: 1.3 lbs
Warranty: Limited lifetime warranty
Finish options: 19 designer finish options available
